before.name: Robert Hiltonsmith
before.description: Robert Hiltonsmith *1981, Greensboro, NC, Senior at Guilford College, Philosophy and Mathematics double major. Anti-war activist; plans to join War Tax Resisters as soon as he starts paying taxes and pursue environmental/civil justice law (under Professor Quigley :-).. Sentenced on 2/10/03 to 3 months in federal prison (self-report), $1,000 fine. This custody record is documented by the SOA Watch Austin prisoner chronology: https://www.soaw-austin.org/POC1983_2012.php
